quality.review_scope: Independent quick and sampled deep audit accepted the as-prepared CdS route across all five supplied main pages and figures. No SI located or reviewed. Raman laser-heating size evolution remains characterization context, not another synthesis route.
missing_fields: Cadmium stock water volume and therefore cadmium stock concentration.
Numeric reaction temperature, reaction duration and Na2S addition rate.
Separation method, wash count/volumes, and drying conditions.
Direct TEM particle diameter/morphology and measured atomic coordinates.
conflicts: The method calls the precipitation room-temperature, but also says the cadmium stock is stirred at a slightly elevated temperature during Na2S addition; no numeric value resolves this.
